name: Esseth
source:
Esseth is in charge of the haunted house's special effects - costumes, lighting... and maybe a few pranks on their fellow monsters.

Their snakes make a lot of the decisions (and contribute a surprising amount to Esseth's fashion choices).

[From [url=https://sad-ghost-studios.itch.io/werehouse]itch.io[/url]]
